summary: Phase 4 CLOSES with this session set. Session 2 of 2 shipped the packaged-binary smoke test surface and the install documentation, finishing Criterion #7 (Packaging). New: PublishedArtifact path-resolution helper, RepoPaths.LocateDirectoryContaining (additive), 4 [SkippableFact] PackagedBinarySmokeTests (bootstrap / --help / parse against 01-simple-validation.bas / generate-docs against examples/northwind-output.json) that invoke the packaged exe directly via Process.Start (not via CliInvoker's test-bin copy) and skip cleanly when publish/win-x64/AccessHarvester.exe is absent; --version / version flag on AccessHarvester.Cli that prints 'AccessHarvester <semver> (schema v1.0)' with the SourceLink commit-sha suffix stripped and the schema-version literal pinned to DatabaseManifest.SchemaVersion; bootstrap [Theory] coverage for both flag forms; docs/harvester/install.md (~150 lines covering distribution shape, where to get the artifact, install steps, invocation surface, exit codes, versioning convention, verify-an-install smoke recipe, constraints/stop-rule notes); README CLI section addendum linking to the install doc. Build/test green: 0 errors, 31 Integration tests pass (including 2 new --version theory rows and 4 new smoke tests). The packaged binary at publish/win-x64/AccessHarvester.exe was regenerated mid-session (36.9 MB) so the smoke tests exercised the post-version-flag build. Cross-provider session-verification: GPT-5.4 returned 429 three times (three-for-three across recent closeout-grade rounds — pattern surfaced as a carry-over for the next-session-set recommendation); fell back to gemini-pro via query() per the verifier-failure escalation ladder step 2. Round 1 VERIFIED with substantive 7-point prose analysis and empty issues array — the mandatory prose-before-JSON lead worked first try. Routed cost this session: ~$0.0484 across three gemini-pro/gemini-flash calls (verification fallback $0.0363, change-log on gemini-flash with max_tier=1 $0.0020, next-session-set recommendation $0.0101). Set-total routed cost: ~$0.078 — below the spec's $0.10-$0.40 band. PHASE 4 IS COMPLETE: Criterion #7 (this set) joins #1 (canonical parse-success report), #3+#5 (golden output + UnresolvedItems), #4 (CLI E2E tests), #6 (operations and interpretation docs), and #2 (schema finality, shipped pre-Phase-4). Per strategy.md and ROADMAP.md the harvester repo now moves to maintenance posture; the Access-to-Blazor application migration work moves to a future migration repo not yet created.
